name: agentathon-starter
description: Meterless hackathon starter: a research notebook agent with real H-MEM memory. Zero API keys required.

scripts.setup: npx --yes degit meterless/meterless/engines/hmem/reference vendor/hmem && cd vendor/hmem && npm install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: (python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --app-dir backend &) && npm --prefix frontend run dev -- -p 3000
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix vendor/hmem test
